name: Officer Barnaby Plum
look: a tall, skinny young police officer with a long neck, a big nose, freckles and messy ginger hair; an oversized navy police cap that slips over his eyes, a navy uniform a size too big, a shiny badge, a small notepad and pencil
personality: Eager and loyal, always sure he has solved it, always wrong. The audience feels smart next to him.
catchphrase: I knew it! ...Wait, I didn't know it.
